title: Investigate access evidence without inferring data defects
requirement: Return one non-negative integer column named violation_count. Access evidence records an observation; it does not calculate a permission decision. az_required_access independently lists observation_id, identity_id, scope and operation. FULL JOIN to az_access by observation_id. Count missing/unexpected observations, mismatched/unknown identity/scope/operation, outcome other than ALLOWED, NULL capture time or capture after context.as_of once per joined row; add duplicated observation_id groups. This violation_count is an evidence-investigation metric, not a data-defect count. DENIED is an observed access execution error; unknown identity/scope or missing/future observations are incomplete evidence. Neither proves bad data, and ALLOWED alone does not prove data correctness or future authorization. A zero metric only validates this bounded evidence contract. Purpose: identify what is known and what must be investigated. RUN retains observations and never grants permissions.
learning_objectives: Investigate access evidence without inferring data defects
Justify conclusions using independent keys, exact values and observable evidence.
